events.label: Искусство
entries: 1926 – King Roger, an opera about Roger II of Sicily by Karol Szymanowski, is premiered at the Grand Theatre in Warsaw.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1982 – The People's Armed Police is de facto founded; It is officially established 10 months later on April 5, 1983
1990 – The Communist Party of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic is founded in Moscow.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1785 – The Boston King's Chapel adopts James Freeman's revised prayer book, without the Nicene Creed, establishing it as the first Unitarian congregation in the United States.
1978 – Garfield's first comic strip, originally published locally as Jon in 1976, goes into nationwide syndication.
